The authors explicitly license source code and pretrained models under MIT in
their paper: https://github.com/deezer/spleeter/blob/master/paper.md
Paper: https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.02154

Beatstitch adapts the unchanged trained U-Net weights to its existing PyTorch
runtime. TensorFlow SAME padding, skip connections and normalization are
preserved. The official supported 16 kHz frequency setting and average mask
extension retain high frequencies. Numeric checkpoint conversion is deterministic
and does not execute the saved TensorFlow graph or require TensorFlow at runtime.
The network and complete audio frontend/synthesis were checked against upstream
TensorFlow inference. These checks establish implementation accuracy, not that
separation will be clean for every recording.

TensorFlow is used only in the isolated development reference check; the app
does not ship TensorFlow or the experimental third-party checkpoint reader.
